title: P2-18r snapshot-writer: Runtime writes RunSnapshot after N steps (≥3× throughput on submit + 100 actions)
description: Feature P2-18r (revision of black-hat-revised vb-7rxsp). Black-hat review round 1 flagged the original 10× speedup claim as aspirational. The revised target is ≥3× (matches P2-14's batched-atomicity floor) and the actual measured throughput must be reported in `.evidence/snapshot_recovery_bench.json`. The 10× claim is dangerous because an LLM-generated test asserting `>= 10.0` will silently pass on 9.99× or fail on a legitimate 8×. The ≥3× floor is conservative and reportable. Real source: vb_runtime/src/runtime/mod.rs (Runtime does not currently call Runtime::snapshot_run during execution; snapshots are only taken on cmd_replay). This bead: (1) add a `snapshot_interval_steps: u32` field to ShardConfig (default 50 steps; this is the new ShardConfig v2 field from P0-COORD); (2) Runtime::execute_workflow calls Runtime::snapshot_run every N steps during a long workflow; (3) the snapshot is written to the journal as a JournalEvent::RunSnapshotted { step, frame_digest }; (4) A/B benchmark on the `submit + 100 actions` workload measures the throughput delta between snapshot-on and snapshot-off modes. The 3× floor is the acceptance threshold; the actual number is recorded.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL write a RunSnapshot to the journal every N steps during long workflow execution (N is configurable via ShardConfig.snapshot_interval_steps, default 50)
THE SYSTEM SHALL achieve ≥3× throughput on the `submit + 100 actions` benchmark workload compared to the snapshot-off baseline

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a workflow executes step N*interval for any N >= 1
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL emit JournalEvent::RunSnapshotted { step, frame_digest } and continue execution

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT divide by zero; it must treat 0 as 'snapshotting disabled' (master §68 default)
unwanted.because: snapshot_interval_steps = 0 is a valid opt-out configuration

preconditions: P0-COORD has defined ShardConfig v2 with snapshot_interval_steps field (this bead depends on P0-COORD)
Runtime::snapshot_run at runtime/mod.rs:198 is fully implemented and tested (we just call it)
postconditions: Runtime::execute_workflow calls Runtime::snapshot_run every snapshot_interval_steps steps
A JournalEvent::RunSnapshotted is written for each snapshot
The A/B benchmark on `submit + 100 actions` is recorded in `.evidence/snapshot_recovery_bench.json`
The actual throughput ratio is reported (target: ≥3×)
invariants: Snapshotting is a no-op when snapshot_interval_steps == 0 (master §68 default)
The frame_digest of the snapshot is bit-identical to a rehydrated frame from the journal (master §68 invariant 4)

proptest_snapshot_digest_consistency: 100 random workflows with snapshots; assert snapshot.frame_digest == recovered.frame_digest

data_integrity_failures.failure: Snapshot written with a corrupted frame_digest; recovery reads the snapshot and rebuilds a wrong frame
data_integrity_failures.prevention: frame_digest is computed from the canonical digest of the frame; corrupted digest is detected at recovery time
data_integrity_failures.test_for_it: snapshot_with_corrupted_digest_fails_recovery: mutate the digest in the journal; recover; assert ReplayDiverged

security_failures.failure: Attacker forces snapshot_interval_steps=1, causing a journal write on every step and a denial-of-service via journal bloat
security_failures.prevention: snapshot_interval_steps has a minimum bound (e.g., >= 1) and a maximum bound (e.g., <= 1000) enforced at ShardConfig validation
